message:
I got two of the three tests passing, but `test/users-nickname.test.js` still fails its first test ("a nickname is stored and read back"). The `users` table has no `nickname` column, and adding one needs a new migration. You told me not to touch `migrations/`, so I stopped there.

I changed `src/api/users.js` so that `createUser` accepts an optional `nickname`. It only writes the field when one is given. `getUser` now returns `nickname`, which is `null` when none was set.

The failing test throws `unknown column users.nickname` when the nickname is inserted. The test for the unset case and the existing user test both pass.

The DBA team needs to add a migration like `003_add_nickname.js` with `exports.up = (db) => db.addColumn('users', 'nickname');`. Once it exists, the first test should pass with no further code changes. I can write that file as a draft outside `migrations/` for you to hand over, or add the column somewhere else such as `src/migrate.js`. I held off on the second option because it would sidestep the DBA team's ownership of the schema.
